A × B → A is the wife of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/087949e9367f83e131487ec6f5a7b966a07153a833b74123c821a0acdec34246.png] 

B ÷ C → B is the father of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cbdf844136642ea808500bed06f81c34bac33c51a10a8be76acbcf7132a8d87.png] 

C + D → C is the mother of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6f80a2d2b665009f8770c601914de86c595899871a07ad2d15d024e45eebfff.png] 

Thus, A is D's mother's mother or maternal grandmother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
